name: Protagonist
source:
The young detective who, while on a mission to search for his long-lost parents, accidentally met Detective Utsugi. He has since worked in the Utsugi Detective Agency after their encounter.

Based on [url=http://www.nintendo.co.jp/n02/shvc/btcj/gallery.html]FDC's gallery page on Nintendo.co.jp[/url]
